name: 12d-convert-xai-empty
description: The empty-array case of convertXAIMessages (prompt-converters.js:785-814): there is no name to prefix and no delete to perform, so the function returns the SAME array instance it was handed -- which `mutated` shows as an empty array on both sides. It is here mainly as the counterweight to 12e: the port must not take the non-array exit for a list that happens to be empty (`.forEach` over [] is a no-op in JS, and the port's index/list checks must agree), and must not invent a placeholder, because unlike the merge/Cohere/AI21 paths this function has no empty-input branch at all.
